label: copy-phase input u (late recall), esp. when next output is m/1/x/h/0/u
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never in the original or delimiter phase), and almost entirely on steps where the fed-back input is the letter u (91% of activation mass). It needs a late recall position: recall_idx >= 4, so mostly t >= 11 in long sequences (L = 8-9). Strength depends on which token is output at that step, i.e. the token that followed u in the original: m, 1, x, h, 0 or u give the strongest firing, and u-after-u bigrams reach the max. A weak secondary set of activations has input x, m or 1 just after a u. Copy-phase u input followed by other tokens (a, z, p, k, q...) is mostly inactive, which is where precision is lost. The predicate gets dev F1 0.60 and mass recall 0.74. Input u alone with recall_idx >= 4 gets mass recall 0.91 but precision 0.19.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=u (+7.95), phase=2 & in_tok=m (+6.39), phase=2 & in_tok=1 (+5.42), phase=2 & in_tok=h (+4.26), phase=2 & in_tok=x (+4.09), phase=2 & out_tok=h (+3.85). Lower it: prev2_tok=<DEL> (-4.11), recall_idx=2 (-4.11), recall_idx=1 (-4.10), prev_tok=<DEL> (-4.10).
